note: SRA just off I-80 at the Grand Island interchange (exit 312) beside the Platte River, with two lakes (non-powered and electric-motor boating only; swimming at the marked beach). Two campgrounds: Mormon Island Campground in the trees north of the west lake, behind the park road, and Lake 2 Cedar Campground on the shore of the east lake, plus a separate tent area. Sandhill cranes gather here in March. Park entry permit required. --Claude
